faq.question: What is Musfiraai?
faq.answer: Musfiraai is a free AI automation platform that builds and delivers AI agents, chatbots, call agents, and n8n workflows at zero cost — operated by Muhammad Usman as an alternative to paid automation agencies on Fiverr and Upwork.

faq.question: What does Musfiraai automate?
faq.answer: Everything paid AI agencies sell: AI agents, custom bots, n8n/Make workflows, call agents, chatbots, YouTube/Amazon/LinkedIn systems — ready-made or on demand, all free.

faq.question: Is this actually free?
faq.answer: Yes — ready systems and on-demand custom builds (n8n, bots, call agents, chatbots) are 100% free with lifetime access. No invoice, no retainer, no hidden tier.

faq.question: Which AI agents does Musfiraai use?
faq.answer: Musfira AI (in-house model) leads the fleet, alongside Gemini, Claude, Meta AI, Edge-TTS, FFmpeg, Playwright, n8n, and OpenRouter as the core production stack, with GPT-4o, Perplexity, Grok, DeepSeek, and more available on request.

faq.question: How do I claim a free automation system?
faq.answer: Message WhatsApp +92 321 7358096 or email musfiraai329@gmail.com with what you need. We map the stack, build it, and hand it off — free.

faq.question: Is Musfiraai automation compliant with platform rules?
faq.answer: Yes. Every pipeline includes retry logic, rate-limit handling, and SHA-256 deduplication designed to operate within each platform's terms of service.

faq.question: How fast can Musfiraai build a custom system?
faq.answer: Timelines depend on scope, but most single-platform systems are delivered within a limited number of free build slots per month — contact via WhatsApp for current availability.

faq.question: What happens after the free build slots run out?
faq.answer: New claims wait for the next month's slot batch, but anything already handed off stays yours permanently — nothing gets revoked, paused, or paywalled after delivery.

faq.question: Do I keep the source code and access after handoff?
faq.answer: Yes — every system ships as complete, ready-to-run code files, yours to keep permanently. You connect your own API keys or accounts for any platform the system integrates with. No lock-in, no dependency on Musfiraai staying involved for it to keep running.
